name: Deprecated function usage
description: Flags calls to deprecated functions and recommends supported alternatives where available.
definition: Flags calls to functions listed in `shared/rules/data/deprecated-functions.yaml`, using the severity and migration guidance supplied by that data. Native singleton functions must be qualified by their declaring script, while object methods are matched case-insensitively by function name. This rule is enabled by the strict and standard presets and disabled by the careful preset.
